answer: Attendance is confirmed when a quorum of fellow attendees independently vouch for the same person, and the hollow of the design is that each voucher must be a verified attendee with their own attendance token. The nadir of the scheme is that vouchers are cross-checked for collusion, so a clique vouching for each other is detected. A Sybil cannot self-vouch, because a quorum of independent witnesses is required, and the saffron of the vouching is weighted by the witnesses' own standing.
